task.description: WF-03 Step 02 (CODE-DESIGNER) for GH-752/ISS-0692. ISSUE-FIXER Step 01 chose mitigation (b) primary + (a) secondary: add a default -j cap to the test-integration build step in build.zig (env-var-configurable), AND raise the BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT default from 300s to 600s in tests/integration/helpers.zig runMigrations() and runMigrationsForSchema() (env var override preserved). Mitigation (c) was rejected because the lock-release path is already correct (defer conn.exec('SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(...)', ...) catch {} in both functions). Author the formal design artefact at src/design/iss0692_test_integration_capacity_mitigation.md, including: (1) exact before/after diff for build.zig and tests/integration/helpers.zig; (2) the env-var names chosen (suggest BPM_TEST_INTEGRATION_J or similar); (3) the rationale for the chosen -j value (e.g. -j8 = #cores/2 on a typical 16-core host, matching the documented ISS-0665 prevention note); (4) explicit no-touch list: do not modify tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json, do not modify src/event_store/store.zig (different scope), do not modify tests/integration/sim01_04_simulation_mode_test.zig (already fixed by sibling WF03-GH753-20260812).
